high_level_description: A glowing neon sign artwork for a fictional record shop, pink and blue tubing on a dark background, shown straight on, presented flat and front-on as artwork, glowing against a dark empty background, centered symmetrical composition, the sign fills the middle of the frame with dark space around it, no wall texture and no building.

style_description.aesthetics: eighties record shop nostalgia, saturated tube glow
style_description.lighting: self illuminated, none, glowing, mixed pink and blue
style_description.art_style: medium shot, waist up, shot at eye level, neutral perspective, 50mm lens, true-to-eye perspective, f4, vivid

compositional_deconstruction.background: a plain near-black background with a soft coloured halo around the tubing

elements.desc: a flowing retro script in hot pink neon tubing with a continuous glass stroke, a straight blue neon underline beneath
